title: Verify Notion and external tool workflows end to end
what: Support real Notion search, page and database reads, authorized writes and context-to-code workflows through the Connector/MCP boundary. Implement the required authentication lifecycle and personal/shared connection semantics; do not treat a configured URL as a working integration.

acceptance.text: A Slack request can locate an authorized Notion specification and use it in a GitHub task
Authorized page updates preserve existing content and report the resulting link
Missing access, expired authentication and rate limits are explained without leaking credentials
Cross-workspace resource access and unauthorized writes are rejected
Live verification uses a dedicated test page with cleanup and no production document damage
